prompt: α-Halogenation (HVZ-style for ketones): acetone + Br2, cat. HCl. Draw the mono-α-bromo product.
explanation: Under acid, enol tautomerizes slowly then reacts with Br2 → α-bromo ketone. Each α-bromination makes the next one SLOWER (EWG destabilizes further enolization), so stops at monobromination. Under BASE, each halogenation is FASTER (anion stabilization) → poly-halogenation (haloform reaction).
